verify_commands.command:
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python -c 'import re, subprocess, sys
BASE="cbc02f0e591d4c6811bb1bfbd87885e62098198a"
PATTERN=re.compile(r"^#!|#\s*(?:noqa\b|type:\s*ignore\b|pragma:\s*no cover\b|fmt:|ruff:|pyright:|mypy:)")
def lines(ref, path):
    raw=subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{ref}:{path}"], text=True)
    return [line for line in raw.splitlines() if PATTERN.search(line)]
for path in sys.argv[1:]:
    before=lines(BASE, path)
    after=lines("HEAD", path)
    if before != after:
        raise SystemExit(f"directive/shebang lines changed: {path}")' tests/interfaces/facades/test_attestation_parity_heldout_2e16.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_programmatic.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_central_mount_gate_ad9f.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli_argparse.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli_js_safe_integers.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_fsck_structured_326f.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_http_transport.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_js_safe_integers.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_list_read_surface.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_push_status.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_stateless_transport.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_plan_review_attestation_facades.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_verify_completion_facades.py
